CheckTitle: Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the root account
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks whether the root user is protected by a hardware (non-virtual) MFA device.
Risk: Virtual MFA lives on a phone or workstation that can itself be lost, cloned or compromised; the root user warrants the strongest, tamper-resistant factor.

Recommendation.Text: Register a hardware MFA device (FIDO security key or hardware TOTP token) for the root user and remove any virtual MFA device.
